articles.title: Die Linke score stunning election victory in Berlin
articles.description: GERMANY’S Left party (DL) has scored a stunning victory in Berlin, winning a state election for the first time on a campaign to nationalise housing owned by corporate landlords and cap rents.The party won around 26 per cent of the vote on Sunday, with Chancellor Friedrich Merz’s incumbent Christian Democratic Union (CDU) trailing in second place, just ahead of the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) which took 16 per cent.
